About Aloy

Not Your Average Emcee.

I’m Aloysius Ho, but you can call me Aloy. I’ve been telling stories and speaking on stage since I was 7, picking up awards along the way. I’ve also spent 11 years in Malaysia’s dance and performing arts scene.

Dance is a big part of what I do, so I understand the battles, the music, and what matters to the dancers. Since 2018, I’ve hosted 100+ events across KL and beyond, from workshops with 50 people to shows with over 1,000 in the crowd.

My style is energetic, interactive, and easy to connect with. Whether it’s a dance battle, a company dinner, or a wedding, I want your guests to feel part of it.

The Emcee Who Gets Your Event.

Every crowd is different. I read the room, find the right energy, and make sure your guests feel included.

  • I Know the Dance Scene

    With 11 years in the scene, I understand the battles, styles, and judging. I help the crowd follow along and give the dancers their moment.

  • Energy from Start to Finish

    From the first welcome to the final countdown, I keep the crowd involved and adjust the pace as the event goes.

  • Getting the Crowd Involved

    A little banter, a few games, and the right moment to make some noise. I help guests warm up without forcing it.

  • Keeping Things on Track

    I work with your team to keep the programme moving. If there’s a delay or a last-minute change, I help keep the audience engaged.

  • Bilingual English + Mandarin

    I host in English and Mandarin, switching naturally so more of your guests can follow along and join in.

Built For Every Stage.

🕺
Dance Competitions

K-pop covers, street battles, or freestyle jams. I keep the rounds moving, build up the big moments, and give the dancers and crowd plenty of energy.

🏢
Corporate Events

Annual dinners, award nights, product launches, and team gatherings. I keep things organised while helping your guests relax and enjoy themselves.

💍
Weddings

From welcoming your families to getting everyone onto the dance floor. English and Mandarin hosting that feels warm, personal, and fun.

🎪
Roadshows & Launches

Mall activations, brand roadshows, launches, and cultural festivals. I get people curious, bring them closer, and give them a reason to join in.
